hooks.command: IN=$(cat); CMD=$(printf "%s" "$IN" | sed -E "s/.*\"command\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"((\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*)\".*/\\1/"); UNQUOTED=$(printf "%s" "$CMD" | sed -E "s/\\\\\"[^\"]*\\\\\"/ /g; s/'[^']*'/ /g"); printf "%s" "$UNQUOTED" | grep -qE "(^|[[:space:]])git([[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$)" || exit 0; printf "%s" "$UNQUOTED" | grep -qE -- "(^|[[:space:]])--amend([[:space:]]|$)" && exit 0; HASREALC=""; printf "%s" "$UNQUOTED" | grep -qE "(^|[[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+-C([[:space:]]|$)" && HASREALC=1; if [ -n "$HASREALC" ] && printf "%s" "$UNQUOTED" | grep -qE "(&&|\\|\\||;|\\|)"; then echo "BLOCKED: cannot safely verify JOURNAL.md state -- git -C combined with a compound command (&&, ||, ;, or |) is ambiguous. Run the commit as its own single command." >&2; exit 2; fi; TARGETDIR=""; if [ -n "$HASREALC" ]; then RAWCOUNT=$(printf "%s" "$CMD" | grep -oE "(^|[[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+-C([[:space:]]|$)" | wc -l); if [ "$RAWCOUNT" -ne 1 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: cannot safely resolve git -C target -- ambiguous match in command text." >&2; exit 2; fi; TARGETDIR=$(printf "%s" "$CMD" | sed -nE "s/.*(^|[[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+-C[[:space:]]+(\\\\\"([^\"]*)\\\\\"|'([^']*)'|([^[:space:]]+)).*/\\3\\4\\5/p"); fi; GIT() { if [ -n "$TARGETDIR" ]; then git -C "$TARGETDIR" "$@"; else git "$@"; fi; }; if [ -n "$TARGETDIR" ]; then GITDIR=$(GIT rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null) || { echo "BLOCKED: cannot verify JOURNAL.md state for -C target \"$TARGETDIR\" (not a git repository)" >&2; exit 2; }; else GITDIR=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; fi; { [ -f "$GITDIR/MERGE_HEAD" ] || [ -d "$GITDIR/rebase-merge" ] || [ -d "$GITDIR/rebase-apply" ]; } && exit 0; GIT diff --cached --name-only | grep -qx "JOURNAL.md" && exit 0; echo "BLOCKED: JOURNAL.md not staged. Update JOURNAL.md, then: git add JOURNAL.md" >&2; exit 2
